reviews.title: Frustrating experiences
reviews.text: When I open the app in the morning, it does not continue the audio program that I was listening to like it used to. This thing plays like a tape player that shuffles tapes & if you don’t finish the tape good luck finding it again because it won’t continue playing like an audiobook or Apple Music or everything where people listen to stuff. Also the Home Screen is annoying and plays the same video automatically when opening… every day and it’s a video I’m not interested in and it only did that after the update that also eliminated my play bar so I can’t continue my programs. I’m a multi year subscriber and I have had issues or I have not been able to access the app at times that I was never compensated, but I did argue with them and got an apology that they only gave because I told them they owed me an apology for not having access to something that I paid for, and I was not compensated in anyway.

reviews.title: Horrible Experience
reviews.text: I did not have a good experience with customer service. I attempted to try the free trial and the app charged me for an entire year. reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text: All the ads and videos i see on this app look incredible. You are lead to believe that there is no cost associated with this and then after downloading the app, you only get access to the first 10 seconds of videos before it prompts you to pay a $40 subscription fee. If developers would come by it more honestly or just charge for the app at a base price, they would have way more downloads and success. Do not waste your time if you think this is a free app.
